newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Soft notionnel seeks prop at 128.08.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Soft notionnel seeks prop at 128.08.

text.p: June notionnel futures traded on MATIF will continue to look soft on Tuesday and seek support around 128.08 to 128.10, technical analysts said.

"In the last few days the market has broken sharply lower and the up-trend has been broken as we have come down from 130.76 down to 128.08," said Guenter Redeker, technical analyst at Chase in London.

Notionnel formed a high at 130.76 on May 16 and has since traded down towards 128.08, the low so far on Tuesday. At 0756 GMT, June notionnel futures were at 128.20, down 10 basis points from Monday's close.
Redeker said if 128.08 was broken it would be a relatively short period of time before 127.06, the April 4 low, was tested.

"The weekly charts look pretty dangerous too," he said. "We have broken the up trend and that suggests the market could test substantially lower levels around 126.06. The objective on weekly charts is 125.30 which is the lower boundary of a trend channel."
The 126.06 level marks a weekly low in mid-November.
David Wood, an independent technical analyst near London, agreed the contract was looking soft said it might try to bounce up and fill the recent gap left between 128.58 and 128.78.
"But if it were to get back up there it probably looks to be worth a sell again around 128.75," Wood said.
He said the market would have to get back up to levels around 129.50 to turn around but this was unlikely with the danger to the downside below 128.00.
"The big hole is below 128.00 and goes straight down to 127.00. But it is not likely to get down there today. It is going to hold and jog around here for a while and then try and go down," he said.
At the short end June Pibor was at 96.28, up seven basis points on the day.
